title: Gaussian distribution

title: Bayes' theorem
body: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B): the rule for updating belief with evidence.

title: Fourier transform
body: Any reasonable signal is a superposition of sinusoids: F(ω) = ∫ f(t) e^{−iωt} dt.

title: Noether's theorem
body: Every differentiable symmetry of the action yields a conserved quantity (time → energy, space → momentum, rotation → angular momentum).

title: Gödel's incompleteness theorems
body: Any consistent formal system rich enough for arithmetic contains true statements it cannot prove.

title: Prime number theorem
body: The number of primes below x is asymptotic to x/ln x.

title: Divergence theorem
body: ∮ F·dA = ∫ ∇·F dV.

title: Newton's first law
body: A body remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted on by a net force.

title: Newton's third law
body: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction.

title: Conservation of energy
body: The total energy of an isolated system is constant.

title: Conservation of momentum
body: The total momentum of an isolated system is constant.

title: Conservation of charge
body: Electric charge is neither created nor destroyed.

title: Second law of thermodynamics
body: The entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

title: Third law of thermodynamics
body: The entropy of a perfect crystal approaches zero as T → 0 K.

title: Zeroth law of thermodynamics
body: Two systems each in thermal equilibrium with a third are in equilibrium with each other.

title: Principle of least action
body: Physical trajectories make the action S = ∫ L dt stationary; Euler–Lagrange: d/dt(∂L/∂q̇) = ∂L/∂q.

title: Maxwell's equations
body: ∇·E = ρ/ε₀, ∇·B = 0, ∇×E = −∂B/∂t, ∇×B = μ₀J + μ₀ε₀∂E/∂t.

title: Schrödinger equation
body: iħ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ; the wavefunction's evolution is unitary and linear.

title: Born rule
body: The probability density of a measurement outcome is |ψ|².

title: Pauli exclusion principle
body: No two identical fermions occupy the same quantum state.

title: Einstein field equations
body: G_μν + Λg_μν = (8πG/c⁴) T_μν: matter-energy curves spacetime.

title: Principle of relativity
body: The laws of physics are identical in all inertial frames; c is the same for all observers.

title: Equivalence principle
body: Gravitational and inertial mass are identical; free fall is locally indistinguishable from inertial motion.

title: Standard Model
body: Matter is quarks and leptons; forces are carried by gauge bosons of SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1); mass arises via the Higgs mechanism.

title: Four fundamental interactions
body: Gravity, electromagnetism, weak and strong nuclear forces.

title: Periodic law
body: Element properties recur periodically with atomic number, reflecting electron shell structure.

title: Conservation of mass in reactions
body: Atoms are rearranged, not created or destroyed, in chemical reactions.

title: Le Chatelier's principle
body: A system at equilibrium shifts to counteract an imposed change.

title: Aufbau principle and Hund's rule
body: Electrons fill lowest-energy orbitals first and occupy degenerate orbitals singly with parallel spins first.

title: Chemical bonding
body: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonds arise from electrostatics and quantum sharing of electrons; VSEPR predicts molecular geometry.

title: Hess's law
body: Reaction enthalpy is path-independent: sum the enthalpies of component steps.

title: Avogadro's law
body: Equal volumes of gases at equal T and P contain equal numbers of molecules.

title: Cell theory
body: All living things are made of cells; cells arise only from pre-existing cells.

title: Evolution by natural selection
body: Heritable variation plus differential reproductive success produces adaptation and common descent.

title: Central dogma of molecular biology
body: Information flows DNA → RNA → protein (with reverse transcription as an exception).

title: Genetic code
body: Triplet codons of nucleotides map to 20 amino acids; the code is nearly universal.

title: Mendelian inheritance
body: Genes come in alleles that segregate and (when unlinked) assort independently.

title: Homeostasis
body: Organisms regulate internal variables via negative feedback.

title: Energy flow in ecosystems
body: Energy flows one way from producers through trophic levels with ~10% transfer efficiency; matter cycles.

title: Germ theory of disease
body: Many diseases are caused by microorganisms.

title: Chemiosmosis
body: ATP synthesis is driven by proton gradients across membranes.

title: Plate tectonics
body: The lithosphere is divided into plates moving over the asthenosphere, driving earthquakes, volcanism and mountain building.

title: Uniformitarianism
body: The same physical processes operating today shaped Earth in the past.

title: Law of superposition
body: In undisturbed strata, younger layers lie above older ones.

title: Greenhouse effect
body: Atmospheric gases absorb and re-emit infrared radiation, warming the surface.

title: Rock cycle
body: Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks transform into one another.

title: Big Bang cosmology
body: The universe expanded from a hot dense state ~13.8 billion years ago; evidence: CMB, Hubble expansion, light-element abundances.

title: Stellar nucleosynthesis
body: Stars fuse hydrogen into helium and heavier elements; the heaviest form in supernovae and neutron-star mergers.

title: Kepler's first law
body: Planets move on ellipses with the Sun at one focus.

title: Kepler's second law
body: A line from Sun to planet sweeps equal areas in equal times (conservation of angular momentum).

title: Shannon source coding theorem
body: Data can be compressed to its entropy H = −Σ p log₂ p bits per symbol but no further.

title: Church–Turing thesis
body: Any effectively computable function is computable by a Turing machine.

title: Scientific method
body: Observe, hypothesise, predict, test by experiment, revise; claims must be falsifiable and reproducible.

title: Dimensional homogeneity
body: Every valid physical equation has identical dimensions on both sides; functions like exp, log, sin take dimensionless arguments.
